Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops

Class SaltSaturationResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops.SaltSaturationResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class SaltSaturationResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable diagnostics from adding a dissolved salt to activity saturation.

The added amount is expressed as salt formula units. The result describes the existing CalcSaltSatauration bracket and bisection calculation; it does not represent a solid phase or qualify the underlying COMPSALT or activity-model parameters.

Version:
1.0
Author:
